{{short description|Brazilian chemist, expert on polymers (1924-2019)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Eloisa Biasotto Mano''' (October 24, 1924 – June 8, 2019) was a Brazilian [[chemist]] and full university professor. She was a specialist in [[polymers]], and enjoyed worldwide recognition for her work. She was a recipient of the [[National Order of Scientific Merit]].

==Early life and education==
Eloisa Biasotto Mano was born in [[Rio de Janeiro]], October 24, 1924.<ref name="1ima">{{cite web |title=LUTO – Professora Eloisa Biasotto Mano – Instituto de Macromoléculas / UFRJ |url=http://www.ima.ufrj.br/noticias/luto-professora-eloisa-biasotto-mano/ |publisher=Instituto de Macromoléculas Professora Eloisa Mano |accessdate=11 January 2020 |language=pt-BR |archive-date=11 January 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200111003227/http://www.ima.ufrj.br/noticias/luto-professora-eloisa-biasotto-mano/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> She received degrees in [[industrial chemistry]] (1947), [[chemical engineering]] (1955), and a [[doctorate]] in [[organic chemistry]] (1960). She studied polymer science at the [[University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign|University of Illinois]] and at the [[University of Birmingham]].<ref name="abc">{{cite web |title=Morre, aos 94 anos |url=http://www.abc.org.br/2019/06/14/morre-aos-94-anos-a-academica-eloisa-biasotto-mano/ |publisher=Acadêmica Eloisa Biasotto Mano |accessdate=11 January 2020 |language=pt-BR}}</ref>

==Career==
In Brazil, she formed the first group of researchers in the area of polymers, which gave rise to the Institute of [[Macromolecule]]s of [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]] (UFRJ), later renamed in her honor. Mano taught [[organic chemistry]] at the Institute of Chemistry, UFRJ, where she was a full professor. She supervised many master's and doctoral theses. In her classes, Mano was always keen to demonstrate practically the properties of different materials and their characterizations. She received the National Order of Scientific Merit for her contribution to science. She was a full member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] since 1978.<ref name="2cnpq">{{cite web |title=pioneiras-view - Portal CNPq |url=http://memoria.cnpq.br/web/guest/pioneiras-view/-/journal_content/56_INSTANCE_a6MO/10157/1144245 |website=memoria.cnpq.br |publisher=Brazilian National Council for Scientific and Technological Development |accessdate=11 January 2020}}</ref><ref name="3Mulher">{{cite web |title=Mulher 500 Anos - Por trás dos panos |url=http://www.mulher500.org.br/acervo/biografia-detalhes.asp?cod=23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110825165819/http://www.mulher500.org.br/acervo/biografia-detalhes.asp?cod=23 |url-status=dead |archive-date=25 August 2011 |accessdate=11 January 2020 |date=25 August 2011}}</ref> In 1994, she became Professor Emeritus.<ref name="abc" />

Mano died in Rio de Janeiro, June 8, 2019.<ref name="1ima" />

==Awards and honors==
* 2000, Grand Cross, [[National Order of Scientific Merit]]<ref name="abc" />
* 2000, City of Rio de Janeiro Award for Science and Technology<ref name="abc" />
* 2001, Simão Medal, Matias, Brazilian Chemical Society (SBQ)<ref name="abc" />
* 2003, creation of the Profa Prize. Eloisa Bro, Brazilian Polymer Association<ref name="abc" />

==Selected works==
* ''Praticas de quimica organica'', 1969
* ''Modified Lignan Polymers from the Resin of Paraná Pine Tree Knots''
* ''Introducao a polimeros'', 1999
* ''Identificação de plásticos, borrachas e fibras'', 2000
* ''Tensile behavior of irradiated recycled polyolefin plastics'', 2000
* ''Química experimental de polímeros'', 2004
* ''Meio ambiente, poluição e reciclagem'', 2005
* ''O impacto do acordo NAS/CNPq na evolução da Química no Brasil: o setor de polímeros'', 2007
* ''Natural Polymer Characterization'', 2007
* ''Polímeros como materiais de engenharia'', 2019
